{"verdict":"proceed",
 "decision":"Build T-467 end to end now. Add content cards near the end of Day 2 for every attendee, whatever their funnel pick. The cards are: context bucket, content tools, formats and cadence, first batch, approve on the review site, and schedule in Metricool. These replace or absorb the thin D2.33 and D2.34 cards, which only showed when Blog or Social posts was picked. Add a Day 3 card for the weekly content loop. Take the substance from ~/revops-content-engine-playbook and ~/content-engine. Ship the teaching with pins, the coverage rows and the playbook sections with the cards, written in the Backlinko voice with no dashes. Use only approved vendors: Metricool for social, Tantra/Resend for the newsletter, and the blog on the funnel Worker. Never name Beehiiv, Notion or WordPress. Leave the dashboard to T-468 and the OS kit to T-469. Run check-guides, probe-details, probe-onboarding-tabs, probe-headings and probe-visual-tools, fix any failures, commit and push to main, then set the task to review with Adi.",
 "why":"The spec (REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md, Content engine row T-467) lists the exact cards and says done means probes pass. All of it is content and code work on our own repo, so no input from Adi is needed (orchestrator-autonomy, approved-vendor-stack).",
 "outward_ok":["git commit and push to main of adisuja/3-day-tantra-ai-revops-workshop","publish the updated centre and playbook pages to our own GitHub Pages mirror"],
 "reassign_to_claude":true,
